violations return EPERM</font>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="405" width="580" x="110" y="175" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="l4" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;verticalAlign=top;align=left;spacingLeft=10;spacingTop=8;fillColor=#ffe6cc;strokeColor=#d79b00;fontSize=11;" value="<b>NoNewPrivileges=yes</b><br><font style="font-size:10px">Blocks setuid/setgid escalation — agent cannot elevate via SUID binaries or capabilities</font>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="315" width="480" x="160" y="235" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="l5" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;verticalAlign=top;align=left;spacingLeft=10;spacingTop=8;fillColor=#f8cecc;strokeColor=#b85450;fontSize=11;" value="<b>AppArmor profile (enforce mode)</b><br><font style="font-size:10px">Filesystem + capabilities — deny sys_ptrace, sys_admin, net_raw, dac_override, setuid/setgid</font>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="225" width="380" x="210" y="295" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="l6" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;verticalAlign=top;align=left;spacingLeft=10;spacingTop=8;fillColor=#e1d5e7;strokeColor=#9673a6;fontSize=11;" value="<b>sudo -u &lt;unix_user&gt;</b><br><font style="font-size:10px">OS user separation — helm-temporal / helm-platform / helm-health (no login shell, home 700)</font>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="135" width="280" x="260" y="355" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="l7" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;verticalAlign=middle;align=center;fillColor=#1e4d78;strokeColor=#1e4d78;fontSize=11;fontColor=#ffffff;" value="<b style="color:#ffffff">claude --project-dir</b><br><font style="font-size:10px;color:#cce5ff">Agent process</font>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="57" width="180" x="310" y="415" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>
